# Momentum continues through week five as total HealthSherpa 2023 enrollments climb to 3.4 million


By[Emily Duffee](https://blog.healthsherpa.com/blog/author/Emily%20Duffee)


Share this post


This week’s HealthSherpa Marketplace insights show a continued positive trend toward a successful 2023 Open Enrollment season for the ACA Marketplace. HealthSherpa added just over 700k lives last week to bring total enrollments up to 3.4 million members so far this season.*
